title_sq: Vile luksoze ne shitje prane TEG!
description_sq:
Vile luksoze ne shitje, pjese e nje rezidence te sapondertuar, prane TEG!
Vila eshte pjese e nje rezidence ekskluzive, me nje komunitet te perzgjedhur banoresh, ne nje zone ideale banimi sic eshte Mjull Bathorja, e njohur per natyren e mrekullueshme, afersine me qendren tregtare TEG dhe fare prane rrugeve hyrese-dalese te kryeqytetit.
Kjo vile ka nje siperfaqe trualli prej 787m2 dhe siperfaqe ndertimi prej 510.5m2.
E ngritur ne 3 kate, kjo vile organizohet ne menyre te tille :
- Kati -1 (nentoke) me nje siperfaqe totale prej 166.5m2, organizuar ne nje sallon te madh, palester, sauna, 2 tualete, dhoma teknike dhe garazhdi i mbyllur per 4 makina.
- Kati i pare (kati perdhe) ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 169.3m2, te organizuar ne korridorin hyres, sallonin e ndenjes, ambientin e gatimit/ngrenies totalisht te vecuar, nje dhome gjumi, nje studio dhe dy tualete, te gjitha keto ambiente aksesojne lehtesisht dy oborret e viles, ku tek ai perpara mund te shijohet dhe pishina.
- Kati i dyte me nje siperfaqe totale prej 174.7m2, ku ndodhen 3 dhoma gjumi, secila me tualetin perkates dhe ballkon te orientuar lindje, nderkohe qe dhoma matrimoniale ka dhe garderoben e saj.
Vila eshte perfunduar vitin e kaluar, me punime teper cilesore, termoizolim, hidroizolim, me sistem kondicionimi qendror, instalimet elektrike - hidraulike cilesore (cdo prize/celes ka linje te vecante), e shtruar me parket druri ne te gjithe siperfaqen e saj, e pajisur me elektroshtepiake te firmave me te mira ne treg, si dhe ofrohet totalisht e mobiluar ne menyre bashkohore, ku cdo detaj eshte kuruar me kujdes nga arkitekt te mirenjohur.
Vendodhja ideale, hapesirat e bollshme, orientimi dhe planimetrite fantastike te ambienteve jane disa nga arsyet pse kjo vile eshte nje mundesi fantastike banimi.
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!
title_en: Luxury villa for sale near TEG!
description_en: Luxury villa for sale, part of a newly renovated residence, near TEG! The villa is part of an exclusive residence, with a selected community of residents, in an ideal residential area such as Mjull Bathorja, known for its wonderful nature, proximity to the TEG shopping center and very close to the entrance-exit roads of the capital. This villa has a land area of ​​787m2 and a construction area of ​​510.5m2. Raised on 3 floors, this villa is organized as follows: - Floor -1 (ground floor) with a total area of ​​166.5m2, organized in a large living room, gym, sauna, 2 toilets, technical rooms and closed garage for 4 cars. - The first floor (ground floor) has a total area of ​​169.3m2, organized in the entrance corridor, the living room, the completely separate cooking/dining area, a bedroom, a study and two toilets, all these rooms easily access the two courtyards of the villa, where the swimming pool can be enjoyed in front of it. - The second floor with a total area of ​​174.7m2, where there are 3 bedrooms, each with its own toilet and east-facing balcony, while the master bedroom has its own wardrobe. The villa was completed last year, with high-quality works, thermal insulation, waterproofing, with a central air conditioning system, high-quality electrical and plumbing installations (each plug/cell has a separate line), laid with wooden parquet throughout its surface, equipped with household appliances from the best brands in the market, and is offered fully furnished in a contemporary way, where every detail has been carefully curated by an architect well known. The ideal location, the ample spaces, the orientation and the fantastic floor plans of the premises are some of the reasons why this villa is a fantastic residential opportunity. For more information contact!
